notes: Sizes are breakpoint-swapped px, not fluid — scale converted to rem at a 16px root (13/15/21/38/62/74px); the 38px step is the <1300px display size, 74px the >=1300px one, so treat them as one display register rather than two ranks. leading given as ratios (0.92 display, 1.67 body = 25/15px). No `color.dark` block: the probe's craft.theme.dark reports bg rgba(0,0,0,0) / accent rgba(0,0,0,0) — artefacts of forcing the scheme, not a real dark theme; meta.color_scheme is `normal` and the site never re-themes. Black surfaces (footer, newsletter modal, off-canvas menu) are inverse *surfaces* on a light page, captured in roles. `accent` is #000000 because the site has no chromatic accent — #F95936 and #B0E9AC exist only as form error/success tints and must not be read as brand hues. grid.columns_* are 0 on purpose: the layout uses zero CSS Grid; a flex `.grid` utility with a -6px/+6px negative-margin gutter (12px effective) composes 60/40, 40/60 and 50/50 rows. Shadows are the layered low-alpha falloff under product cut-outs on the #EEE plate, trimmed from the raw probe strings; layout surfaces carry none. Site-authored @keyframes: zero (the two counted are `spin` and the OneTrust cookie SDK's fade) — every effect is a CSS transition on a JS-toggled class. reduced_motion: prmRules=0 — add a fallback on reuse.
